bibliographic-data.invention-title: BLENDUNGS- UND OKKLUSIONSKOMPENSATION FÜR KRAFTFAHRZEUG- UND ANDERE ANWENDUNGEN
COMPENSATION D'ÉBLOUISSEMENT ET DE VISUALISATION OCCLUSE POUR DES APPLICATIONS AUTOMOBILES ET AUTRES
GLARE AND OCCLUDED VIEW COMPENSATION FOR AUTOMOTIVE AND OTHER APPLICATIONS

abstract.p: Often when there is a glare on a display screen the user may be able to mitigate the glare by tilting or otherwise moving the screen or changing their viewing position. However, when driving a car there are limited options for overcoming glares on the dashboard, especially when you are driving for a long distance in the same direction. Embodiments are directed to eliminating such glare. Other embodiments are related to mixed reality (MR) and filling in occluded areas.
